Container.Name: zombies-hub
Container.Overview: A private server for playing Call of Duty Zombies together. Players open its page in Chrome, join a room and start a game. Players on other machines need the page over HTTPS: put a reverse proxy with a certificate in front of TCP 3075 (in Nginx Proxy Manager: a proxy host with Cache Assets off and Websockets Support on). The games use UDP 3075, which your router must forward straight to this server, not through the proxy. Repository is the image's address: localhost:5000/zombies-hub:latest from a registry on this server, or zombies-hub:latest after docker load. Set WebUI (Advanced View) to the page's HTTPS address. To open the server's console, press Console and type: console
Container.Requires: A copy of the install folder of Black Ops or Black Ops II. For the page: a domain name and a reverse proxy with HTTPS. For the games: UDP 3075 forwarded from your router.

Config.Name: Games (UDP)
Config.Description: The port the games use. Players connect to it from browsers (WebTransport) and from Windows. Forward it from your router, without a proxy.

Config.Name: Page (TCP)
Config.Description: The page and its downloads, over plain HTTP. Point your reverse proxy at it. Your router does not need to forward it.

Config.Name: Game files
Config.Description: A folder with one folder per game: t5 is a copy of the Black Ops install folder (the one that contains zone), and t6 is a copy of the Black Ops II install folder. At least one is needed. The server only reads them.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: What the server keeps: players and leaderboards (zombies.db), a log of each game (logs/), and its downloads.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: The map a new room starts with. zombie_theater is Kino der Toten. The room's host can pick another.

Config.Name: Download rate
Config.Description: Empty: the server sends no game files, and players use their own copy of the game. Set: the server sends the game files to browsers, and to the launcher of a player whose PC has no copy of Black Ops II, at most this many bits per second in total. 40M is 40 Mbit/s, about 5 MB per second. 1G and unlimited also work.

Config.Name: Discord client ID
Config.Description: For Discord sign-in: your Discord application's client ID (discord.com/developers/applications). In the application's OAuth2 settings, add the page's address followed by /auth/discord/callback as a redirect. Empty: anyone who reaches the page can play.

Config.Name: Discord client secret
Config.Description: Your Discord application's client secret.

Config.Name: Discord server
Config.Description: Only members of this Discord server can play. Enter its ID: turn on Developer Mode in Discord's Advanced settings, right-click the server and choose Copy Server ID. Empty: any Discord account can play.

Config.Name: Discord roles
Config.Description: Only members with one of these roles can play. Enter the role IDs, separated by commas. Empty: any member can play.

Config.Name: Min players
Config.Description: Players a room needs to start a game: 1 to Max players. With 2, a single player plays with the lobby's Play local. With 1, a single player plays on the server, but a one-player game is not on the leaderboards.

Config.Name: Max players
Config.Description: Most players a room and its game can take: 1 to 8. A new room takes 4, and its host can change that, from Min players to this number. The maps were made for 4 players. Above 4, players share the four characters: the fifth player gets the first player's.

Config.Name: Max games
Config.Description: Most games running at once. Each uses about half a GB of memory, and more as it goes on.

Config.Name: Public port
Config.Description: The UDP port players reach the games on from outside, when your router's port forward uses another port than 3075.

Config.Name: Load timeout
Config.Description: How long a game waits for its players to load before the server calls it off.

Config.Name: Hang timeout
Config.Description: How long a game may go without drawing a frame before the server ends it and returns its players to their room. 0 turns this off.

Config.Name: Game arguments
Config.Description: Extra command line for every Black Ops game, such as +set g_deadChat 0.

Config.Name: Engine URL
Config.Description: Another download address for the Black Ops engine. {version} is replaced with the release, such as v1. Empty: the releases of bo1-zombies on GitHub.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user that owns what the server writes in Config. The games' own folders (game/) belong to user 3075.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group that owns what the server writes in Config, including the games' folders.
